command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
x=json.loads(Path('.pi/frontier.json').read_text())
print('frontier_id='+str(x.get('frontier_id'))); print('source_commit='+str(x.get('source_commit')))
print('ops_sha256='+str(x.get('artifact',{}).get('ops_sha256'))); print('canonical_ops_sha256='+str(x.get('artifact',{}).get('canonical_ops_sha256')))
print('score='+str(x.get('metrics',{}).get('score'))); print('nonce='+str(x.get('nonce',{}).get('default')))
for name, roots in [('scored',['src/point_add']),('trusted',['src/bin','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo'])]:
 files=[]
 for root in roots:
  files += subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--',root],text=True).splitlines()
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 for s in sorted(set(files)):
  p=Path(s)
  if p.is_file():
   b=p.read_bytes(); h.update(s.encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(b).digest())
 print(name+'_tree_sha256='+h.hexdigest())
print('ops_bin_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(Path('ops.bin').read_bytes()).hexdigest() if Path('ops.bin').is_file() else 'ops_bin=MISSING')
print('score_json='+Path('score.json').read_text() if Path('score.json').is_file() else 'score_json=MISSING')
PY
